quest.title: For the Future's Sake, Experiment!
quest.description: Having completed Frejus and Chenee's remote cannon experiment, it's time to go back and talk to them.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x30000, Adventurer's Experience x6

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: The data indicates that this invention is a success. Thank you both.

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: Yup, thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: See, I told you this would go well! With your genius in play, Frejus, this remote-controlled cannon thing was a piece of cake!

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: I—I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: In that case, let's get cracking with the next awesome gadget — and I have a great idea for one, too!

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: What about an airship that can explore the skies?

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: Or a mega drill that can bore deep underground?

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: Hah...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Feels like she's trying to make his life difficult on purpose...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Those might be a bit of a tall order...

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: I mean, you're the one who rejected the Institute's offer three times. I'm sure you can make stuff even they can't, right?

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: Of course. I can only say that it will be tricky, but not a big deal.

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: *sigh* You know what? I don't want those things anymore. Flying up into the sky or delving into the earth both sound boring. It's cold up there, and it's stuffy down there.

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: I share that sentiment.

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: In that case, could you make something that we'd use normally? ...Ooh, that's right! I love sleeping in in the mornings, so could you make me an automatic oven that bakes on its own?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well now, that sounds possible.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Her earlier suggestions were intentionally impossible, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: Alright, let me consider how this might be designed.

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: Nice! I'll take that as agreement — and if it does prove impossible, you'll just have to make me breakfast in the future, eh, Frejus?

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: What? What sort of request is that... In any case, you needn't worry, I'm sure such a small invention is well within my skill. I am, after all, a "genius."

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: Hmm... Judging by the experimental data, there might still be a few issues with this invention. In any case, thank you both for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: Yup, thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: Aw, are you feeling discouraged, Frejus? Don't worry! If a genius like you is having trouble, that just means that this research angle was problematic from the start!
